title: pvGlyphWithCustomSource
body:
## pvGlyphWithCustomSource

Like pvGlyph, but the glyph geometry is any polydata connected to the GlyphSource input (e.g. a CAD part or a custom marker), placed at points or cell centres, oriented by a vector array and scaled by a scalar or vector array; output is polydata. Use it when the built-in shapes are not enough.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- By ParaView default only up to 5000 points are glyphed (Uniform Spatial Distribution); choose All Points or Every Nth Point when every point must appear.
- OrientationArray and ScaleArray must have the same association; a point/cell mismatch makes the native filter warn and produce no glyphs.
- The glyph geometry is used in its own coordinates: an arrow-like source should point along +x and be centred where it should attach.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `GlyphWithCustomSource`. Identity: `filters/GlyphWithCustomSource`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GlyphSource` | Required data input for the native GlyphSource port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: polygonal data (surfaces, lines or vertices) (vtkPolyData). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkPolyData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to this filter. This is the dataset from which the locations are selected to be glyphed. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GlyphMode` | This property indicates the mode that will be used to generate glyphs from the dataset. | `{"type":"enum","values":["All Points","Every Nth Point","Uniform Spatial Distribution"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"All Points"` |
| `GlyphTransform` | The values in this property allow you to specify the transform (translation, rotation, and scaling) to apply to the glyph source. | `{"type":"typed proxy","choices":["Transform2"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `{"type":"Transform2"}` |
| `MaximumNumberOfSamplePoints` | This property specifies the maximum number of sample points to use when sampling the space when Uniform Spatial Distribution is used. | `{"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `OrientationArray` | Select the input array to use for orienting the glyphs. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"maxItems":2,"minItems":2,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE","REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `ScaleArray` | Select the input array to be used for scaling the glyphs. If the scale array is a vector array, you can control how the glyphs are scaled with the **Vector Scale Mode** property. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"maxItems":2,"minItems":2,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE","REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `ScaleFactor` | Specify the constant multiplier to use to scale the glyphs. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `Seed` | This property specifies the seed that will be used for generating a uniform distribution of glyph points when a Uniform Spatial Distribution is used. | `{"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `Stride` | This property specifies the stride that will be used when glyphing by Every Nth Point. | `{"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `VectorScaleMode` | Select the mode when the scaling array is a vector. **Scale by Magnitude** scales the glyph by the vector magnitude. **Scale by Components** scales glyphs by each vector component in the dimension that component represents, e.g., the x-direction is scaled by component 0, the y-direction is scaled by component 1, and so on. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Scale by Magnitude","Scale by Components"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Scale by Magnitude"` |

### Nested `GlyphTransform` → `Transform2`

Syntax: `{"type":"Transform2","options":{...}}`. Native identity: `extended_sources/Transform2`. Omitted nested options retain native values on subsequent visits.

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GlyphTransform.options.Rotate` | Rotation [rx, ry, rz] of the glyph shape about its local axes, combined in VTK’s Z-X-Y convention (the matrix is RotateZ · RotateX · RotateY); for a rotation about a single axis the order does not matter. The operation then turns the glyph’s x axis onto the orientation vector, so this rotation changes which part of the shape follows the vector. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `GlyphTransform.options.Scale` | Scale factors [sx, sy, sz] applied to the glyph shape along its local axes before any other scaling, for example to make arrows thinner without shortening them. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `GlyphTransform.options.Translate` | Offset [tx, ty, tz] of the glyph shape, applied after its scale and rotation; for example [-0.5, 0, 0] centres a unit-length arrow on the data point. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvGlyphWithCustomSource",
  "inputs": {
    "GlyphSource": "UPSTREAM_GlyphSource",
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
